description: Individuals who can provide basic palliative care to seriously ill patients and their families. Their focus is on improving quality of life and managing symptoms, encompassing areas like symptom assessment, communication, ethical decision-making, and end-of-life care. These individuals support patient as their companions and are also trained to use assistive and comfort devices while providing care.
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA
